description: A process carrying a dispatched task id (`MULTIVERSE_TASK_ID`) is not Nexus, so a plain `activity inbox` there still shows new mail but refuses to advance the cursor and says so on stderr; `--as-nexus` authorizes that same process to acknowledge anyway, advancing the cursor exactly like a Nexus-context read. `--replay-since`/`--replay-last` never acknowledge regardless of context (enforced by `clap`'s own `conflicts_with` on `--peek`/`--as-nexus`) and read straight off the log by physical position/seq.

expect.stdout:
[<TIMESTAMP>] sandbox: hello there
current through event 1 as of <TIMESTAMP>
last peeked at <TIMESTAMP>, through event 1
sequence numbers are per project and cannot be compared across projects.
expect.stderr: not acknowledged: this process carries a dispatched task id (<ID>), not sandbox2's Nexus — a specialist must never advance the cursor the Nexus's own mail read depends on. Pass --as-nexus if that is wrong, or --peek to look without it.

expect.stdout:
[<TIMESTAMP>] sandbox: hello there
current through event 1 as of <TIMESTAMP>
last read at <TIMESTAMP>, through event 1
